source_instruction: searching to purchase a men's zerogrand hiker boot that is water resistant with rubber outsole in a size 10 1/2, either dark coffee or black in coloring.  cole haan.
query: I stopped by the community park on my walk over here earlier, and the whole stretch of oak trees along the main path is shedding so many acorns right now that every step crunches loud enough to scare off the squirrels darting back and forth stashing snacks for winter. There was a golden retriever puppy off leash zooming through the leaf piles, skidding every time it tried to turn too fast, and its owner was laughing so hard they could barely call it back when it made a beeline for a group of kids passing around a thermos of hot cocoa. The air smells exactly like damp fallen leaves and the faint wood smoke from the fire pits people set up on their patios a few blocks over, and it’s the kind of crisp fall day that makes you glad you layered an extra flannel under your jacket even if your nose gets a little pink by the time you get where you’re going. I’ve heard the men’s boots section carries pairs that are water resistant, with a tough rubberized cork outsole that holds up on slick sidewalks. I’ve heard those pairs come in a colorway that’s dark coffee mixed with black, in a men’s size 10.5, and I’ve heard there are options there at a good price that doesn’t feel like a total ripoff for what you’re getting.
